niche: Executive coaching for US mid-market SaaS founders who just crossed $2M ARR and feel stuck as the bottleneck
offer: The Operator Reset — 8-week 1:1 coaching intensive ($8.5k) that installs a weekly operating rhythm so the founder stops being the default decision-maker and reclaim 10+ hours/week
icp: US-based SaaS founders / CEOs, typically 30–48, $2–12M ARR, team of 12–40, still in most hiring loops and product calls. They know they should delegate but keep jumping back in. Buyers are the founder (sometimes co-signed by a spouse or co-founder). They hate fluffy mindset coaching; they want calendars, decision rules, and accountability.
cta_preference: Book a 20-min Operator Fit Call (Calendly) — soft CTA most days; hard CTA on Fridays
notes: Jordan prefers short paragraphs, numbers over adjectives, and never uses 'crush it' / '10x' / 'hustle'. Avoid fake revenue claims. Mention The Operator Reset by name 3–4 times across the pack, not every post.
